content.value_statement: Coverage percentages alone cannot show whether tests are reliable, focused, or effective. This skill assesses quality dimensions and produces prioritized, evidence-based improvements.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates correctness, readability, maintainability, reliability, and execution speed.
Reviews statement, branch, function, and line coverage in context.
Identifies test pollution, over-mocking, flaky timing, hidden dependencies, and unfocused assertions.
Calculates JavaScript and TypeScript test counts, file ratios, line ratios, and pattern indicators.
Explains mutation scores, surviving mutations, test pyramid balance, and prioritized improvements.
limitations: The metrics script supports common JavaScript and TypeScript test file conventions.
Static indicators cannot prove that a test is flaky, correct, or valuable.
Meaningful analysis requires access to relevant source files, tests, and available reports.
Framework-specific APIs and advanced patterns require a dedicated framework skill.

use_cases.title: Review a Pull Request
use_cases.description: Assess changed tests for reliability, coverage gaps, readability, and maintainability before approval.

use_cases.title: Improve a Legacy Suite
use_cases.description: Find brittle patterns, shared state, weak assertions, and high-impact refactoring priorities.

use_cases.title: Plan Quality Gates
use_cases.description: Interpret coverage and mutation results to define practical quality targets for continuous integration.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Test Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these tests for clarity, isolation, and meaningful assertions. List the three most important improvements with evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small test file

prompt_templates.title: Coverage Gap Analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this coverage report with the related source and tests. Prioritize uncovered branches and suggest valuable scenarios without chasing percentages.

prompt_templates.title: Reliability and Maintainability Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this test suite for timing dependencies, shared state, over-mocking, hidden dependencies, duplication, and weak async handling. Rank findings by impact.

prompt_templates.title: Comprehensive Quality Assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess coverage, mutation results, reliability, maintainability, performance, and test pyramid balance. Produce scored findings, evidence, priorities, and an actionable improvement plan.

output_examples.input: Review a unit test file that uses shared mutable fixtures and several unrelated assertions.
output_examples.output: High priority: reset fixtures for every test to prevent order dependence. Split unrelated assertions into focused behavior checks with descriptive names.

output_examples.input: Analyze a report with high statement coverage but weak branch coverage around payment failures.
output_examples.output: Coverage is broad but misses risky decisions. Add declined payment, timeout, retry, duplicate request, and partial failure scenarios before increasing thresholds.

output_examples.input: Interpret a mutation report with surviving boundary and boolean operator changes.
output_examples.output: Surviving mutations indicate weak boundary and condition assertions. Add exact threshold cases and tests where each boolean condition independently changes the outcome.

best_practices: Provide source, tests, coverage data, and mutation results when available.
Prioritize business risk and defect detection over a single coverage percentage.
Verify each recommendation against framework behavior and project constraints.
anti_patterns: Do not treat high coverage as proof of effective tests.
Do not classify every mock, setup hook, or timeout as a defect without context.
Do not apply generic thresholds without considering risk, suite type, and execution cost.

faq.question: Which testing frameworks are supported?
faq.answer: The analysis principles are framework-agnostic. The bundled metrics script recognizes common JavaScript and TypeScript test file names.

faq.question: Does this skill run my tests?
faq.answer: It can guide test and coverage analysis when tools are available. Execution depends on your environment and granted permissions.

faq.question: Can it detect flaky tests?
faq.answer: It identifies indicators such as arbitrary delays, shared state, and weak async handling. Repeated execution is still needed to confirm flakiness.

faq.question: Is code coverage enough to measure quality?
faq.answer: No. Coverage shows executed code, but reliability, assertion strength, mutation results, and business risk provide essential context.

faq.question: What does mutation testing add?
faq.answer: Mutation testing changes code and checks whether tests fail. Surviving changes reveal assertions or scenarios that may be weak.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect evidence-based findings, quality dimensions, prioritized recommendations, coverage gaps, reliability concerns, and suggested next steps.
